item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Diya must construct a $70^{\circ}$ angle with ruler and protractor, as suggested by the diagram.

Which plan correctly builds that angle?

options.A: Call the finished drawing the vertex and stop there.
options.B: Seat the protractor centre on the vertex but leave the base arm off the $0^{\circ}$ mark before marking $70^{\circ}$.
options.C: Choose a vertex and one base arm, seat the protractor centre on the vertex, align the base arm with $0^{\circ}$, mark $70^{\circ}$, and draw the second arm through that mark.
options.D: Mark $70$ only because that number is printed largest in the stem.
